lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you see AKT surge 10.2% on CoinGecko? It’s now ranked #8 — and it’s not slowing down.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This is a big deal because decentralized cloud computing is finally getting its moment in the spotlight.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Akash Network is an open-source blockchain that lets anyone rent out unused server space globally.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Its unique proof-of-stake model rewards users for contributing bandwidth and storage — no middlemen.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Developers and businesses are starting to use it for cheaper, more scalable cloud solutions.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Akash is making blockchain infrastructure accessible — and it’s gaining real-world traction.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how this could change the future of the internet? Follow for the breakdown.
